items.title: Build or verify the local Docker Codex runner image
items.context: Create or reuse a minimal local Docker image that can run codex exec non-interactively for a sterile probe.

happy.desc: Docker image build or reuse reports codex-cli version from inside the container

edge.desc: Runner records unavailable second-account auth as pending_auth instead of claiming a second live account

adversarial.desc: Visible container inventory proves no host home, .codex, .lattice, Cell03 full outputs, or lattice-Paper paths are mounted

items.userSees: User sees probe-summary.json report dockerImage.status=pass and containerCodexCliVersion populated, with account-b reported as pending_auth if no second auth bundle exists.

items.title: Generate sterile probe row inputs and shard manifests
items.context: Prepare two to five local probe rows with allowlisted task files, prompt, budget, tool policy, and input manifests only.

happy.desc: Probe manifest contains two to five Cell06/A2prime rows with stable inputManifestDigest values

edge.desc: Account/shard manifest distinguishes account-a live path from account-b pending-auth path without duplicating row ownership

adversarial.desc: Sterile input packaging excludes hidden/reference files and known Cell03/Proofbound-memory contamination tokens

items.userSees: User sees probe-manifest.json listing 2 bounded Cell06/A2prime probe rows, stable inputManifestDigest values, and explicit shard/account ownership.

items.title: Run the local Docker probe and capture receipts
items.context: Run a bounded probe through the container path, capture Codex events, final messages, receipt metadata, and account/shard ownership.

happy.desc: At least one Docker-run probe row captures codex container execution metadata and receipt shape

edge.desc: Rows that cannot run because a second auth bundle is absent are explicit pending_auth receipts, not successful provider rows

adversarial.desc: No receipt includes reviewer fields, Cell03 output references, Proofbound memory pack ids, or host workspace paths

items.title: Validate contamination scan and merge checks
items.context: Run checks that reject forbidden terms, duplicate ownership, missing manifest digests, and reviewer contamination.
excludes: paper claim upgrades and product gate changes

happy.desc: validate-probe accepts the generated summary and rows and reports PASS

edge.desc: Validator rejects duplicate row/account ownership, missing manifest digests, or wrong Cell06/A2prime labels

adversarial.desc: Validator negative controls reject injected Cell03, reviewer, Proofbound-memory, or host-path contamination
